offer.text: I've sketches enough to fill a book, but it's dark and my drafting table is across rough ground. Keep me safe and I'll lead us back to it before my notes blow away.

accept.text: Splendid. Mind the path while I mind the maps.

decline.text: Then I'll clutch my papers and risk it alone.

in_progress.text: The table's this way — keep the dark off my back.

ready.text: My drafting table! Now the real work begins.

complete.text: Every line I draw tonight, I owe to you. My thanks, escort.
